## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, frank-faced fellow with broad shoulders, curly brown hair, and roguish hazel eyes. He was rather thin and pale during periods of intense study and illness at college. As a boy, he often wore a teasing smile. As an adult doctor, he looks notably young for his profession.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 c29 P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 c39 P22](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0022), [v4 c2 P14](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0014)_

## Personality

Gilbert is clever, ambitious, hardworking, and intensely studious. He possesses a strong sense of humor, a good-natured disposition, and a capacity for deep, self-sacrificing kindness. Though playful and teasing in his youth, he grows into a thoughtful, honorable, and deeply devoted husband. He is passionate about his career and enjoys lively intellectual debates on philosophical and political topics.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v3 c25 P25](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0025), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v4 c14 P3](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0003)_

## History

Gilbert Blythe grows up in Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, returning to school after spending three years in Alberta with his ailing father. Upon returning, he becomes the academic rival of Anne Shirley after teasing her by calling her 'Carrots.' Though Anne holds a grudge against him for years, Gilbert repeatedly attempts to apologize and secretly holds deep affection for her, even saving her from a sinking dory. He earns his First Class teacher's license at Queen's Academy and generously surrenders his teaching post at Avonlea to Anne, taking a job at White Sands instead. During his teaching years, he co-founds the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and decides to pursue a career in medicine. Gilbert attends Redmond College alongside Anne, where he excels academically, is elected Freshman Class President, and captains the football team. He proposes to Anne in their second year at Redmond, but she initially rejects him, leading to a distant period where Gilbert focuses on his studies, works for the Daily News, and is rumored to be courting Christine Stuart. After graduating with High Honors and the Cooper Prize, he falls dangerously ill with typhoid fever; upon learning that Anne loves him, he recovers rapidly and they become engaged. Gilbert completes his medical degree and takes over the practice of his great-uncle, Dr. David Blythe, in Four Winds Harbor. He marries Anne at Green Gables and settles into a small house o' dreams, establishing a highly successful medical practice by saving patients like Rhoda Allonby and earning the deep respect of the community.
